common.tagline: Staying well after TMS, one small step at a time
common.errorBody: It's not your fault. Please try again in a moment.
common.notMedicalDevice: Not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat, and it does not replace your care team. In an emergency, call 112.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change it anytime in Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: This app helps you stay well at home after your TMS treatment: short check-ins, small ideas for each day and an easy way to reach your care team.
welcome.disclaimer: This app is not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat, and it never replaces your care team. In an emergency, call 112.

consent.title: You decide, sensor by sensor
consent.subtitle: Everything is optional. The app works without any of these, and you can change them later.
consent.movementDesc: Uses the motion sensor during exercises to count active minutes.
consent.tapsDesc: A short tap game. Only your average speed and accuracy are kept.
consent.locationDesc: Only to estimate time outside in daylight. Processed on your phone; coordinates are never saved.
consent.vibrationDesc: Gentle vibrations that guide breathing and other exercises.

companion.title: Choose a companion
companion.subtitle: A small friend to keep you company. Just for comfort.

baseline.title: A first, short check-in
baseline.subtitle: This shows where you're starting from. There are no right or wrong answers.

checkin.title: How are you today?

anxiety.question: How tense or anxious do you feel?

sleep.question: How many hours did you sleep last night?

game.title: Tap when the circle glows
game.intro: A short game of {{rounds}} rounds. Only an average is saved, never each tap.
game.off: The tap game is off in your privacy settings, so we'll skip it.
game.circle: Reaction circle. Tap when it glows.

safety.title: One more question
safety.question: In the last few days, have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
safety.context: We ask everyone this. Your answer helps your care team support you.

note.question: Anything you'd like to note?
note.placeholder: A few words, if you like (optional)

checkin.alreadyDone: You've already checked in today. If something changed, you can check in again.

crisis.title: You're not alone
crisis.body: If you are in danger or might hurt yourself, please get help right now. Reaching out is a strong thing to do.
crisis.contactTeamSent: Your care team has been notified (simulated in this demo). They will contact you as soon as possible.
crisis.urgentSent: Because of your answer, your care team has been alerted (simulated). Please don't wait if you feel unsafe.
crisis.breathe: Breathe with me for a minute

today.title: Today

trend.better: Your mood has felt a bit lighter this week.
trend.steady: Your week has been fairly steady.
trend.harder: This week seems heavier than the last. That's okay — let's take it gently.
trend.notEnough: After a few check-ins, you'll see your week here.

plan.title: Your small plan for today
plan.subtitle: Just ideas. Any one of them counts.

suggestConsult.title: Would it help to talk to someone?

today.urgentNotice: Your care team was alerted today (simulated). If you feel unsafe, call 112.

voice.dog: I'm so happy to see you!
voice.bird: I saved a little song for you.

context.welcomeBack: Welcome back. It's good to see you.
context.lowMood: Yesterday felt heavy. Let's be extra gentle today.
context.midMood: One small thing at a time is enough.
context.highMood: It's lovely that things felt lighter yesterday.
context.daylight: Days are short now — even 10 minutes of daylight helps.
context.night: Rest matters too. Tomorrow is a new day.

checkin.low: Thank you for telling me. Heavy days pass — let's do something small and kind.
checkin.mid: Thanks for checking in. Steady is good.
checkin.high: I'm glad today feels good! Let's keep it gentle.
checkin.urgent: Thank you for being honest. You deserve support — please reach out now.

companion.suggestConsult: {{name}} noticed the last days seem harder. Would you like to talk to your care team? It's your choice.

breathing.title: Guided breathing
breathing.why: Slow breathing calms the body's stress response.

daylightWalk.title: Daylight walk
daylightWalk.why: Daylight supports your body clock and mood, especially in dark months.

reachOut.title: Message someone
reachOut.why: A small connection can lift the day.
reachOut.howTo: Send a short message to someone you like. "Thinking of you" is enough.

move.title: Move with me
move.why: Gentle movement releases tension and adds a little energy.

fireplace.title: Fireplace
fireplace.why: Watching a slow fire helps the mind rest.

fish.title: Fish in the lake
fish.why: Calm, slow movement gives busy thoughts a break.

puzzle.title: Calm puzzle
puzzle.why: A gentle task can quiet busy thoughts. No timer, no mistakes.

gratitude.title: One good thing
gratitude.why: Noticing small good moments supports recovery.
gratitude.howTo: Think of one small thing that went okay today. That's all.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.subtitle: Calm things to do, at your own pace.

breathing.finished: Nicely done. Notice how you feel.

fireplace.hint: Just watch the flames. Stay as long as you like.

fish.hint: Tap the water gently, or tilt your phone.
fish.tiltOff: Tilt is off because the movement sensor isn't enabled.
fish.a11y: A calm lake with fish swimming slowly. Tap to make ripples.

puzzle.hint: Slide the tiles into order. No timer, no mistakes.

move.hint: Move in any way that feels good, for 2 minutes. Sway, stretch or dance.
move.movementOff: The movement sensor is off — just move along with the beat.
move.finished: Lovely moving! {{minutes}} active minutes added to today.

walk.daylightToday: Today has about {{hours}} hours of daylight.
walk.locationOn: Using approximate location to estimate time outside. Coordinates are never saved.
walk.locationOff: Location is off. Using Helsinki daylight, and you can log time outside yourself.
walk.outside: Time outside so far: about {{minutes}} min
walk.manualQuestion: About how many minutes were you outside?
walk.saved: Saved {{minutes}} minutes of daylight. Well done.
walk.permissionDenied: Location permission wasn't given, so you can log time outside yourself.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Your last 14 days, in plain words.
insights.reactionNote: Lower is quicker. Slower days are common when tired.
insights.empty: Not enough data yet. Check in a few times to see your trends.
insights.helpsBody: Based on your ratings and how you felt the next day.
insights.helpsEmpty: Rate a few comfort activities and we'll show what helps you most.

care.title: Care
care.subtitle: Your care team (fictional, for this demo).
care.noSlot: No free times in the next 48 h
care.noRequests: No requests yet. You can ask for a chat anytime.
care.replied: Your care team has replied and will contact you (simulated).
care.urgentAlert: Urgent alert sent {{time}}. Your care team was notified (simulated).

consult.title: Request a consultation
consult.reasonQuestion: What would you like to talk about?

urgency.low: It can wait a few days

consult.whyTitle: What your care team will see
consult.noReasons: Nothing worrying stood out in your recent days.
consult.unsafe: If you feel unsafe, don't wait — call 112.
consult.urgentRouted: Because of today's safety answer, this went straight to your care team as urgent (simulated).

reasons.moodDrop: Your mood has been lower than the week before
reasons.lowMood: Your mood has been low on several days
reasons.missedCheckIns: There were several days without a check-in
reasons.activityDrop: You've been moving less than usual
reasons.reactionSlower: Your tap game has been slower than usual
reasons.perceivedUrgency: You told us it feels urgent

reasons.crisisLanguage: Words in a message suggested you may be at risk

privacy.title: Privacy center
privacy.intro: In this version, your data stays on this phone. You decide what is collected.

items.checkins: Check-ins: mood, energy, tension, sleep and optional notes — to show your trends.
items.reaction: Tap game: only your average speed and accuracy — tiredness can show up here.
items.movement: Movement: active minutes during exercises — never raw sensor data.
items.location: Location: only whether you're outside during a walk. Coordinates are never saved.
items.where: Where: only on this phone. No account and no cloud yet.
items.sharing: Sharing: your care team only sees a summary when you request a consultation, or if a safety answer needs urgent help.

privacy.exportBody: Creates a file with everything stored, which you can save or send.
privacy.deleteBody: This removes your check-ins, settings and history from this phone. It can't be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.largeTextDesc: Makes text bigger, on top of your phone's text size.
settings.aboutBody: {{app}} supports wellbeing after TMS treatment. It is not a medical device: it does not diagnose or treat, and it does not replace your care team. In an emergency, call 112.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.subtitle: For presentations. Uses synthetic data only.

chat.disclaimer: {{name}} is a supportive companion, not a therapist. In an emergency, call 112.
chat.heroSubtitle: Here to listen, check in with you and help you find small things that help.

open.invite: Shall we check in? It only takes a minute.
open.done: You've already checked in today. I'm here if you want to talk.

flow.askMood: How are you feeling right now?
flow.askEmotions: Which words fit best? Pick as many as you like.
flow.askNote: Anything you'd like to tell me about it? Write freely, or skip.
flow.askSafety: One question we ask everyone: in the last few days, have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
flow.didntGetMood: You can tap a face, or type a number from 1 to 5.

reply.greeting: Hi! I'm here. What would help right now?
reply.low: I'm sorry it feels heavy. You don't have to fix everything today — let's find one small, kind thing.
reply.anxious: That sounds uncomfortable. Let's slow down together for a moment.
reply.tired: Being tired makes everything harder. Something gentle might help.
reply.positive: That's lovely to hear! Would you like to save this moment in your journal?
reply.thanks: Anytime. I'm here whenever you need me.
reply.fallback: Thank you for telling me. I'm a simple companion, so I can't fully understand everything — but I can help you note how you feel, find something calming, show your progress or reach your care team.
reply.relax: Here's something calming. Ask again for another option.
reply.progress: Here's how your last two weeks look.
reply.care: Your care team is there for you. You can ask for a chat — it's your choice.
reply.careOpen: You already have a request in line. Here's where it stands.
reply.plan: Here are a few small ideas for today. Any one of them counts.
reply.crisis: I'm really glad you told me. You deserve help right now. Please call 112 or a crisis line. I've let your care team know (simulated).

journal.title: Journal
journal.subtitle: Notice how you feel. Every entry counts — there's no wrong way.
journal.daysLoggedHint: This number only grows. Missing days is okay.
journal.empty: Your journal is empty. Add how you feel today, or check in with {{name}} in the chat.
